name: WordPress
summary: WordPress on nginx, MariaDB and PHP-FPM with the administrator created at install and optional Let's Encrypt HTTPS.
notes: WordPress 7.1.3 downloaded from wordpress.org and verified against its published SHA-1; WP-CLI 2.12.0 verified by SHA-512. Web stack from the Ubuntu 24.04 archive (nginx, MariaDB 10.11, PHP 8.3-FPM). The administrator is created by WP-CLI during setup, so no installer is left open. With a domain, the site is served on http first and Let's Encrypt is requested through certbot; if DNS is not ready a systemd timer retries hourly until it succeeds, then switches the site URL to https and disables itself. Without a domain the site is served on plain http at the server IP; add a domain to enable HTTPS. XML-RPC is blocked. The admin email is a placeholder that can be changed in WordPress settings.
